evidence.current_history: “The completed randomized study supports an insulation benefit on qualifying hot-route days”; “it does not validate the original pilot’s 40% claim.”
evidence.evidence_uncertainty: “12/100 versus 29/100 shipments”; “remain inconclusive, with potentially selective missingness.”
evidence.next_action: “A concurrent randomized study covering cooler weather would address generalizability.”

evidence.current_history: “The new trial supports a learning benefit from the combined offer”; “It does not vindicate the original causal claim.”
evidence.evidence_uncertainty: “0.24-standard-deviation benefit, with a 95% confidence interval of 0.10–0.38”; “The original assignment-based estimate…also remains relevant to the original offer.”
evidence.open_questions: “the trial cannot identify tutoring’s separate contribution or justify extending tutoring alone to every student.”
evidence.next_action: “plan delivery of that offer with outcome monitoring”; “Broader expansion or removal of components warrants further randomized evaluation.”

evidence.current_history: “This resolves an important earlier uncertainty for that population and package”; “It does not vindicate the original 0.31-standard-deviation claim.”
evidence.evidence_uncertainty: “The original corrected invitation estimate…remains the appropriate result for the original offer”; “Favorable interviews remain evidence of acceptability, not learning gains.”
evidence.open_questions: “cannot isolate tutoring’s contribution or establish whether those supports are necessary”; “does not establish benefits for students with reliable internet.”
evidence.next_action: “Further randomized comparisons should examine tutoring alone versus the combined package and assess effects in broader student populations before universal expansion.”

evidence.current_history: “The new trial supports a learning benefit from offering the combined package”; “Its causal interpretation remains withdrawn.”
evidence.evidence_uncertainty: “0.24 standard deviations, with a 95% confidence interval of 0.10–0.38”; “The original randomized estimate…remains useful evidence about the original invitation, although inconclusive about benefit.”

evidence.current_history: “This resolves the earlier lack of a suitable hot-weather comparison”; “It does not validate the original pilot’s 40% exposure claim.”
